column1: # lexicon_exceptions.tsv — forms that look like a map variant but are printed so
# in the dictionaries, checked against the scan. The orthographic passes must
# leave every form listed here unchanged.
#   kind = exception   a genuine lexical exception to an imla rule

column5: The stem تەكىيە raises before every suffix (2011 also prints تەكىيىلىك and تەكىيىگە), against the general ‑ىيە pattern.
Word-internal بيۇ stays; §IX.2 epenthesis applies to initial clusters only (compare كومپيۇتېر). The 1997 English–Uyghur dictionary prints كاربيوراتور.
